inj.note: The afternoon-long rainy conditions in Tampa Bay and the Falcons' defense's complete inability to slow down the Buccaneers' ground attack led to Mayfield barely putting in any work as a passer. In the process, the Bucs became the first team since 1974 to win a game without a single completion, and the bizarre circumstances left Mayfield's fantasy managers with a dead spot in their lineups. Mayfield will naturally be a lot busier when he travels to the Windy City to face the Bears' aggressive defense in a Week 9 road showdown next Sunday night.

news.h: Bucs down Falcons without pass completion; Bucky Irving, Kenny Gainwell run wild
news.d: Baker Mayfield didn't complete a pass, but the Buccaneers beat the Falcons 16-0 behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell's rushing on a wet, sloppy field.

news.h: Buccaneers beat Falcons 16-0 despite failing to complete a single pass in wet, sloppy conditions
news.d: — Baker Mayfield threw more downfield blocks than he had completions.

news.h: Baker Mayfield needs to attempt only 11 passes in Buccaneers' blowout win
news.d: Baker Mayfield needed to attempt only 11 passes in the Buccaneers' 43-13 victory against the Carolina Panthers on Sunday.

news.h: Bucky Irving runs for 2 TDs and Bucs force 4 turnovers in 43-13 rout of Panthers
news.d: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers wanted to make sure not to put too much on Baker Mayfield's plate with their quarterback still healing from a dislocated thumb and wearing a protective glove on his throwing hand.

news.h: Baker Mayfield returns for Bucs, but WR Emeka Egbuka, RT Luke Goedeke out
news.d: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield will make his return following a three-game absence, but he will be without his top target in wide receiver Emeka Egbuka.
